verdict.rationale: Secureframe's API and CSV upload let users push/import data for many resources at once (e.g., bulk user access data, custom resource mapping), and the MCP server exposes controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, and risks as tools for programmatic access. However, none of the evidence explicitly describes a true bulk operation feature (e.g., batch-update/delete many items in one API call) — it only shows single-object API access and CSV-based bulk import for specific workflows. missing for 10: explicit bulk-update/batch API endpoints, MCP tool examples showing multi-item operations in one call, independent confirmation of bulk action support.
